statement.p: The force \displaystyle{F} (in pounds) needed on a wrench handle to loosen a certain bolt varies inversely with the length \displaystyle{L} (in inches) of the handle. A force of 35 pounds is needed when the handle is 6.0 inches long. If a person needs 15 pounds of force to loosen the bolt, estimate the length of the wrench handle. Calculate using significant digits.

solution.p: Varying inversely means \displaystyle{F}=\frac{{k}}{{L}}. In this case \displaystyle{35}=\frac{{k}}{{6.0}} or \displaystyle{k}={35}\cdot{6.0}={210}.
To loosen this bolt, \displaystyle{15}=\frac{{210}}{{L}}, or \displaystyle{L}\cdot{15}={210}, or \displaystyle{L}=\frac{{210}}{{{15}}}={14}\approx{14}.
